Albanian University in Tirana offers scholarships and fee reductions across its health sciences, law, business and engineering programmes for domestic and international students. The scholarships page lists the current calls, criteria and application steps for each academic year.

Programme Highlights

  • Tirana-based private university with multi-faculty programmes
  • Merit tuition awards and fee reductions
  • Call-specific application windows
  • Affordable Balkans study destination with English-taught options in some programmes

Who Should Apply

Prospective undergraduate and master's students meeting the call's academic criteria; international applicants should confirm language of instruction per programme.

Funding and Costs

Merit-based tuition reductions and full-fee awards depending on the call and study programme. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Review the scholarships page, choose the relevant call, and submit the requested documents before its deadline. Key deadline information: Call-specific deadlines published on the university's scholarships page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Albanian University

Albanian University is a private higher-education institution in Tirana offering programmes in health sciences, law, economics and engineering, with an annual scholarship scheme.

Official website: https://albanianuniversity.edu.al

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Call-specific deadlines published - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
